name: ESLint
summary: AI-assisted issues and PRs are welcome if disclosed, reviewed, tested and edited for readability. AI-generated PRs are only considered for accepted issues, and replies to maintainers must come from a human.

evidence.quote: If you use AI to generate an issue or a pull request, you must clearly disclose this in your submission.
While AI can assist in generating code or text, the ultimate responsibility for the contribution remains with the human submitter.
AI-generated PRs will only be considered for issues that have been officially marked as accepted by the ESLint team.
Issues and pull requests that do not disclose the use of AI may be closed without review.
Please do not feed maintainer comments back into an AI to generate responses.
AI-generated content must be edited to make it easy for maintainers to review.

sources.title: AI Usage Policy - ESLint - Pluggable JavaScript Linter
